06274 `Othniy'el {oth-nee-ale'}

與 06273 和 0410 同源 ; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Othniel 7; 7

俄陀聶 = "上帝的獅子"
1) 迦勒之弟基納斯之子,  迦勒女兒之夫; 約書亞
   去世後, 以色列的第一任士師, 解救以色列人脫離古珊利薩田的壓制
record.edic_text:
06274 `Othniy'el {oth-nee-ale'}

from the same as 06273 and 0410;; n pr m

AV - Othniel 7; 7

Othniel = "lion of God"
1) son of Kenaz, younger brother of Caleb, and husband of Achsah the
   daughter of Caleb and his own niece; first judge of Israel, who
   after the death of Joshua, delivered the Israelites from the
   oppression of Chushanrishathaim
